title: Siefert2024
description: Sleep EEG recordings from 34 participants who underwent Targeted Memory Reactivation (TMR) during sleep, collected to examine whether memory reactivation acts holistically on object memory. Event files describe the cueing sounds and the corresponding satellite objects, including blocked, interleaved, and uncued categories. The data are organized in BIDS format using the FieldTrip data2bids function.
methods_description: Sleep EEG was recorded while a TMR system played sound cues associated with studied objects (satellites) during sleep. Events files log the cue sound index and satellite number, including slow oscillation-tagged trials with no sound. Data were converted to BIDS with FieldTrip data2bids; for five participants a system restart resulted in two EEG files.
